messages:
leo_sales: New POC from HarborWorks next week. They require Okta SSO + SCIM delta every 5m + strict RBAC. Can SE/security confirm feasibility and quick pricing?

anya_se: Got it. Quick clarifying Qs: are they asking SP-initiated SAML or IdP-initiated? Also, expected user count?

leo_sales: SP-initiated. ~8k users initially, could double. They want groups -> app roles and ability to prevent signups from unverified domains.

raj_security: Security checklist highlights: TLS1.2+, SCIM creds rotation, audit logs retention 365d, immediate token revocation on deprovision. Can we meet all?

jo_ops: Hosted: TLS1.2+ yes, audit logs 90d default (365 enterprise add-on), SCIM creds are customer-rotated (we enforce rotation policy). Immediate revocation available for Dedicated/Private; hosted can enable immediate for POC.

anya_se: Rate limits: hosted default 100/min, can configure burst; Dedicated supports sustained 1k/min. For 5m delta every few minutes we'll recommend Dedicated if changes are large.

leo_sales: Pricing ballpark for Dedicated trial + SCIM bump? Need something for procurement now.

jo_ops: Ballpark: Dedicated baseline $7k/mo + SCIM 1k/min feature +$450/mo. Final quote after sizing.

raj_security: Also need domain verification approach documented (DNS TXT proof) and whether delegated subdomain claims allowed.

anya_se: We support DNS TXT verification and periodic re-checks. Delegated subdomain proofs supported via console upload. We'll add runbook snippet and sample mapping JSON.

deploy-bot: Non-prod deploy completed: scim-resume-token + immediate-revoke feature flags enabled in staging.

leo_sales: Thanks team — I'll send these bullet answers to HarborWorks and schedule the pre-POC call.

anya_se: Action items: publish runbook + mapping JSON, confirm final quote, security to fill questionnaire sections by EOD Friday.

raj_security: On it.
